notes.title: 《Lily Fantasia》Makes a Surprise Appearance at the 2025 Taipei Game Show!
notes.content:
Attention, future great pianists! Lily is here to invite you to join us at the 2025 Taipei Game Show and unveil a new chapter of 《Lily Fantasia》! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772273/38d1a44b705bc44fd3ce79ca76f17ed7bea1e773.jpg[/img]

[h2]Taipei Game Show Exhibit Details[/h2]
《Lily Fantasia》is making its debut at the 2025 Taipei Game Show! Experience the full game content firsthand at the venue and earn exclusive rewards for trying out the game!

Venue: Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center, Hall 1, 4F
Booth Name: Justdan
Booth Number: [b]L518[/b]
Exhibition Dates: [b]January 23rd (Thu) – January 26th (Sun), 2025[/b]
Opening Hours: [b]09:00 AM[/b] to [b]05:00 PM[/b]
Playtest Reward: Complete the playtest to receive a limited-edition cleaning cloth featuring Lily! 🎁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772273/8e88c46f2d3172a5d0105cbe5da9b907b077b446.jpg[/img]
[i]Just look at this beautifully designed cleaning cloth! A perfect keepsake featuring Lily’s elegance! 😎[/i]

[h3][b]Special Stage Event: 《Lily Fantasia》[/b][/h3]
[code]
Date: January 23rd (Thu)
Time: 1:30 PM – 2:30 PM
Host: Anna Lee
Special Guests: 6Tan, Xiaoweiba (Little Tail)
Description: Our guests will introduce and playtest 《Lily Fantasia》on stage. There might even be some mysterious surprises waiting for you! 🤫
[/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772273/4349f11a7c7192aaf518ba1080f55bd90b21a0ef.jpg[/img]

[h2]Partner Booth Showcase[/h2]
In addition to Justdan’s booth, we’ll also be featured in our partner’s exhibition area!

[code]
Partner Booth Number: [b]M331[/b] (Jingcheng Technology Co., Ltd.)
Details: Experience 《Lily Fantasia》on three 136-inch ultra-large screens, delivering a stunning visual feast! Try out the game and feel the exhilarating rhythm gameplay on the big screen—a whole new level of excitement awaits! 💻
[/code]

[h3]For those who want to see Lily on the big screen, don’t miss this spectacular visual and musical extravaganza![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772273/35426126b30007d912288794794b7e1e295119a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772273/c91b15fe5033a61313a657dcc92514375fc7a283.png[/img]
[i]*Images are for reference only.[/i]

[h2]Wishlist & Steam Key Giveaway![/h2]
To celebrate our participation in the Taipei Game Show, we’re hosting a special Steam Key Giveaway! ⁉️

[b]How to Participate:[/b]
Add 《Lily Fantasia》to your Steam Wishlist.
Share a screenshot of your wishlist page in the pinned post on Justdan’s Facebook page.
More details can be found in the linked post as per below:
[url=https://www.facebook.com/share/p/14q8rS2doN/]https://www.facebook.com/share/p/14q8rS2doN/[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772273/35eb883acceccc7dfb17c4b74990e0f2b2cc0d3a.png[/img]

[h2]Act Now![/h2]
The demo is now live — add 《Lily Fantasia》to your Steam Wishlist and be among the first to experience the magic of piano!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527300/

Come meet us at the Game Show and discover more surprises in person!
Join Lily on a musical adventure and embark on the path of a Rhythm Master! 🎵

notes.title: Lily Fantasia's Public Demo is LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772273/a4765b60592baa3d44e84d6bb67799e4a450081a.png[/img]
The highly anticipated [b]Lily Fantasia[/b] DEMO is finally available for download on Steam at [b]9:00 PM (UTC+8), January 17th (Friday)[/b]! 🎹

[previewyoutube=PtChPnz6hqc;full][/previewyoutube]

Experience a piano-themed rhythm game in advance! Pick up your magical piano and embark on a musical journey with the mysterious vampire Lily to save her mother!

[h1]Don’t wait! Download the DEMO now and start playing!↓↓↓[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527300/  

[h1]DEMO Content Overview[/h1]
In the DEMO, players can explore two main gameplay modes:  

[h2]🎵Practice Room[/h2]
Here, can you freely play your songs from our Song Collections!
[list]
[*][b]“Welcome to Lily Fantasia!”[/b] includes four songs available for free challenge!  
[*]Songs from [b]“Story Recap”[/b] need to be unlocked by progressing through the [b]Story Journey[/b] mode.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772273/f46cb5a6bc25b497723a21c77f5c7152d582fb56.png[/img]

[h2]🎭Story Journey[/h2]
[*] Experience visual novel-style storytelling and tackle songs with unique gameplay mechanics.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772273/452de521c713e1d87b80af83055c7a15cebbcf1e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772273/a7e46d8c6130041f9db1f7c8d4bfd9e696d91e81.png[/img]
[i]※Note: The DEMO is still under development. If you encounter any errors or bugs during gameplay that affect your experience, we kindly ask for your understanding. We will continue improving to bring you a more polished game![/i]  

[h1]Share Your Valuable Feedback[/h1]
If you have any suggestions, bug reports, or want to share your thoughts about the game, feel free to contact us through the following methods 🎶:  
[list]
[*] [b]Join our Discord[/b]: We have dedicated channels for feedback and bug reports, and you can also share or discuss your experience with other players!  
[*] Discord link: [url=https://discord.gg/uhjjRmsu]https://discord.gg/uhjjRmsu[/url]  
[*] Fill out our feedback forms:  
[*] Post-play survey: [url=https://forms.gle/ydcSSauPgd5b57b49]https://forms.gle/ydcSSauPgd5b57b49[/url]  
[*] Suggestions: [url=https://forms.gle/n6stjCDDAA9DdikKA]https://forms.gle/n6stjCDDAA9DdikKA[/url]  
[*] 
[/list]
[h3]Your feedback helps us optimize the game. Thank you for your support and participation![/h3]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44772273/6ec36f1acedfd7f8f719afb35aa1677ff4b07bba.png[/img]
[i]Join Lily on her journey![/i]  

[h1]Act Now![/h1]
After trying the DEMO, don’t forget to add [b]Lily Fantasia[/b] to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] and be among the first to experience the charm of the piano!  
Lily and we look forward to embarking on the adventure with you!  

Follow us on social media to keep up with Lily’s journey!
